turns.q: Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
turns.replyTail:
menu
The cheaper 3" x 4" ($24) is completely fine and definitely not a compromise on quality—it uses the same 100% pure beeswax and gives you a fantastic, clean burn for about 60 hours.
The 3" x 6" ($32) is only worth the extra $8 if you burn candles daily for 3+ hours at a time, since that extra height gives you 30 additional burn hours at a lower hourly cost.
If money is tight right now, stick with the 3" x 4"—you get the exact same premium performance without spending the extra cash upfront.
